person_note: The diagnostic event quotations repeatedly present Robin and other characters through sustained third-person scene narration, retrospective summary, and free-indirect access to thought. First-person and story-specific second-person pronouns in the quote set occur in dialogue, gnomic statements, or paratext rather than controlling narration. Scholarly whole-book analysis explicitly confirms a third-person limited main narrative following Robin and a separate omniscient footnote voice; that nonparticipating footnote narrator does not create an alternation into first or second person. The author interview corroborates the two-voice structure, though it uses narrator and point of view somewhat loosely. The main remaining limitation is that no accessible Tier A sustained authorized excerpt was found, but the numerous interior quotations and Tier B structural evidence independently converge on THIRD.
